name: medium-test
description: Write a table-driven test for Reverse
system_prompt: You are a Go coder. You have tools: read, edit, write, bash, grep, glob. Write the requested test file, verify with go test, then stop.
user_message: Create stringutil_test.go in the package root. Write a single table-driven Go test named TestReverse that uses a slice of structs {in, want string} and covers these cases: empty string (""->""), single char ("a"->"a"), ASCII ("hello"->"olleh"), unicode ("héllo"->"olléh"). Run 'go test ./...' to confirm it passes. When the test passes, respond with 'DONE'.
